# opalstack_cert (Resource)

A TLS certificate of your own, for a site's `cert_id`. Certificates that Opalstack requests from Let's Encrypt are not managed here: set `generate_le` on the site instead. Everything about a certificate changes in place, so a renewal keeps the id the sites refer to.

Deleting a certificate that a site serves is accepted, and the API silently leaves that site without one. The name of a certificate does not have to be unique.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opalstack_cert" "example" {
  name = "example-com"
  cert = file("${path.module}/example.com.crt")
  key  = file("${path.module}/example.com.key")
}

resource "opalstack_site" "www" {
  name       = "www"
  domain_ids = [opalstack_domain.example.id]
  routes     = [{ app_id = opalstack_app.www.id }]
  ip4_id     = data.opalstack_ip.v4.id
  cert_id    = opalstack_cert.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cert` (String) The certificate, PEM encoded.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The private key, PEM encoded. It is stored in the Terraform state. The provider never reads it back from the API, so it is null after an import until the configuration supplies it.
- `name` (String) Name of the certificate: letters, digits, `_` and `-`.

### Optional

- `intermediates` (String) The intermediate certificates, PEM encoded, if the certificate needs any.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `exp_date` (String) When the certificate expires, as the API reports it.
- `id` (String) UUID of the certificate.
- `sha256_fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By name, or by UUID.
terraform import opalstack_cert.example example-com
terraform import opalstack_cert.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
